map.输入反应物与生成物的浓度及各自化学计量系数，计算反应商 Q，并与平衡常数 K 比: Enter the concentrations of reactants and products and their stoichiometric coefficients to compute the reaction quotient Q, then compare it with the equilibrium constant K to judge the direction of the reaction.
map.Q = [P]^ν_P / [R]^ν_R（气相用分压）。 QK 逆向。: Q = [P]^v_P / [R]^v_R (use partial pressures in the gas phase). QK reverse.
map.输入反应物与生成物的浓度及系数，求反应商 Q 并与 K 比较。: Enter the concentrations and coefficients of reactants and products to compute the reaction quotient Q and compare it with K.
map.方向判定：算 Q 对比 K 知反应向哪走。: Direction: compute Q, compare with K and see which way the reaction goes.
map.初始状态：由投料算 Q 预判趋势。: Initial state: compute Q from the feed composition to predict the trend.
map.平衡点逼近：随反应进行 Q→K。: Approaching equilibrium: as the reaction proceeds, Q approaches K.
map.：输入各物质浓度算 Q，工具对比 K 输出「Q<K 正向进行」或「Q>K 逆向」: Enter the concentrations of each substance to compute Q; the tool compares with K and reports "Q<K, forward" or "Q>K, reverse", and notes that Q = K means equilibrium.
map.由离子浓度求溶度积或反之: Solubility product from ion concentrations, or the reverse
map.Q 和 K 单位一致吗？: Do Q and K Have the Same Units?
map.都用相同活度/浓度基准，K 无量纲（标准态归一）。: Use the same activity or concentration basis for both, then K is dimensionless (normalized to the standard state).
map.达平衡，正逆净速率为 0。: At equilibrium, the net forward and reverse rates are 0.
map.压强变化影响 Q 吗？: Does a Pressure Change Affect Q?
map.气体用分压表达时总压变改各分压，Q 随之变。: When partial pressures are used for a gas, changing the total pressure changes each partial pressure and Q changes with it.
